_help: Add a new achievement by copying one object in 'items' and editing it. Order doesn't matter: items are sorted newest first by 'date'. category must be one of: awards, academic, competitions, leadership, other. Leave out any field you don't have. Anything written as [[ like this ]] is a placeholder.

items.title: RHF 25 Years Award
